description: Schéma Directeur Vélo Métropolitain de Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Cette couche de polylignes décrit les itinéraires vélo du schéma directeur vélo de Rennes Métropole. Il s'agit d'une couche mise à jour régulièrement, qui présente donc des évolutions par rapport à l'état initial du Schéma Directeur Vélo (2018). Ces données schématiques sont destinées à être utilisées à de petites échelles (1:50 000ème). Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are planification, bicyclette, planification des transports. The portal shows 1,220 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-07-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
